description_en: Removes the elastic IP address (EIP) or virtual IP address (VIP) used in a zone from the DNS record
description_zh: 将可用区对应的EIP/VIP从域名解析中摘除
kebab_example: aliyun nlb start-shift-load-balancer-zones --zone-mappings ZoneId=cn-hangzhou-a VSwitchId=vsw-bp1rmcrwg3erh1fh80000 --load-balancer-id nlb-83ckzc8d4xlp8o0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: StartShiftLoadBalancerZones

fields.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch in the zone. By default, each zone uses one vSwitch and one subnet
fields.help_zh: 可用区对应的交换机，每个可用区默认使用一台交换机和一个子网
fields.name: vswitch_id

fields.help_en:
The zone ID of the NLB instance.

You can remove only one IP address (or zone) in each call.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443890.html operation to query the most recent zone list
fields.help_zh:
NLB实例的可用区ID。
一次调用最多支持移除一个可用区。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443890.html接口获取可用区ID
fields.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The mappings between zones and vSwitches.

You can remove only one IP address (or zone) in each call
parameters.help_zh:
可用区及交换机映射列表。

一次调用最多支持移除一个可用区
parameters.name: zone_mappings

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run, without sending the actual request. Valid values:

true: performs only a dry run. The system checks the request for potential issues, including missing parameter values, incorrect request syntax, and service limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and sends the actual request. If the request passes the dry run, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会移除可用区。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token. Ensure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the request ID as the client token. The request ID is different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the NLB instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
NLB实例所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id
